GOOD TO KNOW

No small-print
surprises.

Can I buy broadband today?

No. KiwiKind Broadband is a provider project in development. We need a registered operating business, wholesale agreement and completed launch checks before selling service.

What will it cost?

No retail plans or prices have been confirmed. Future offers must explain the total NZD price including applicable GST, setup, equipment, contract term and cancellation costs before you agree.

Will my home be covered?

We can’t confirm yet. A supplier-backed address check will be needed. Sending a request does not confirm coverage or reserve a connection.

Can this replace an emergency phone?

This app is not an emergency calling service. Broadband and internet-based phones may stop working in a power cut. Any future voice offer needs an assessment of 111 Contact Code obligations and support for vulnerable consumers.

Are you a comparison website?

No. The project is intended to become a retail broadband provider using real contracted wholesale infrastructure. It is not currently an operating ISP.

DRAFT · PRE-LAUNCH · 16 OCTOBER 2026

Privacy, in plain language.

The operating legal entity, NZBN and contact details are not yet confirmed. Public customer intake stays closed until these are configured and the privacy notice is approved.

When intake opens, the portal collects your email and password (stored as a one-way password hash), service address, postcode, contact name, optional phone number, requests, support messages and consent records. It uses these to manage your account, assess a request and respond to you. Required fields are marked in each form; without them we can’t process that action. There are no advertising trackers or marketing opt-ins.

Essential session and security cookies keep you signed in and protect forms. Authorised operators can access records for support and administration. No supplier receives a request through this build. Before any live supplier or hosting arrangement, the operator must document recipients, hosting location and overseas privacy safeguards.

You can export your data in the portal and request access, corrections or account deletion through its privacy support category. No collection is permitted publicly until a direct privacy contact is published, including a route for people unable to sign in. Deletion may require review of legal retention duties. The proposed retention schedule and hosting safeguards require operator approval before launch.

If a privacy concern remains unresolved, you can contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner. This draft must be updated with the real operator and processing arrangements before public intake.

DRAFT · PRE-LAUNCH · VERSION prelaunch-2026-10-16

A request is just a request.

KiwiKind Broadband is a working brand for a planned New Zealand broadband retail business. It is not yet offering a live broadband service. The legal supplier and contact details must be confirmed before customer intake opens.

Creating an account or submitting a request does not form a broadband service contract, guarantee availability, start provisioning, authorise switching or create any charge. Don’t cancel your current broadband on the basis of a request. You may cancel a pending request in the portal.

Only submit accurate details for an address you are authorised to enquire about. Protect your password. Support tickets and complaints are recorded in your account; no pre-launch response time is promised. We do not claim Telecommunications Dispute Resolution membership. A live complaints and escalation process must be approved before service launch.

Any future offer needs separate acceptance of confirmed pricing, GST, speeds and limitations, installation, equipment, minimum term, cancellation and switching terms. Nothing here excludes rights that cannot lawfully be excluded under New Zealand law, including applicable Consumer Guarantees Act and Fair Trading Act protections. These draft portal terms require review before public customer use.
